---
name: vibeschool-architecture-guardrail
description: Prevent competing authority, execution, persistence and control-plane architectures in VibeSchool.
---
# Canonical Architecture Guardrail
Discover the current canonical component before creating a gateway, executor, authority path, store, queue, evidence ledger, certification mechanism, identity resolver, curriculum mapping path, runtime controller or stop control. Extend or repair canonical truth. A replacement requires explicit migration, deprecation, compatibility, rollback and assurance. Never create a second source of truth merely because it is easier locally.
